title: Run ledger
description: The ledger `autopilot` keeps for one run: one entry per checkpoint, in the order reached, each pointing at the `decision` record that carries the frozen card, both judgments and the authority check, and stating the ruling or the escalation. The decision records are the evidence; this is the index a reader follows from the run report the runner holds. Every ruling is ledgered, and at most one escalation is open at a time. A run artifact the runner holds, never a repository path, and this skill makes no knowledgebase call of its own (docs/decisions/0001-kb-document-vocabulary.md §3).

status.description: The run's state when the ledger was last written.

cancellation.description: Who cancelled the run, why and when; null before cancellation.

charter.description: The charter the run is under, by the hash recomputed at load. The charter is immutable for the run: a changed hash is a new charter, and this run does not adopt it.

entries.description: One per checkpoint. An empty list says no checkpoint was reached.

decision.description: The decision record for this checkpoint.

outcome.description: 'ruling' when every check held and the two choices agreed; 'escalation' otherwise, carried on the blocked card's decision record.

answered.description: Whether the human has answered the escalation. The answer settles the card; it is not re-dispatched.

answer.description: The ruling that settled an answered escalation: the option chosen, who chose it, why, and when.
